_comment: Canon config for calibration.mjs (Agent #2) — committable, tunable, NOT PII. targets = the accuracy each gut-word SHOULD map to (knew≈0.95, shaky≈0.65, guessed≈0.30); ECE measures how far actual accuracy drifts from these. window_size/min_reps/trend_delta/danger are the reliability + danger-zone knobs. A deliberate SEED, not sacred — retune from real data. calibration.mjs READS this only (single-writer preserved); if missing, these same values are the built-in defaults.
_opened_2026_08_18: min_reps 20 → 1: calibration_gap and the overconfidence read compute on what he has and carry n. window_size 10 is a WINDOW (the trend needs 2× of it), allowed guessed; danger.min_knew_reps 1 is arithmetic (derived). OPENED 18 Aug 2026 — ORGANISM_OVERHAUL §5.4 (his 1 Aug 'why are we setting numerical limits … everything fully opened' + 13 Aug 'I do not have 30 days to wait for data' + 18 Aug 'full permission'): a guessed number may be a GUARD or a WINDOW, never a BUDGET or a CALENDAR GATE. A speak-gate at 1 is arithmetic (you cannot compute on an empty set), not a wall — the organ speaks on what he has and prints n. Verify: node scripts/limits.mjs (0 guessed gates).
_derivation_window_size: window_size 20 → 10 (the trend gate's need is 2 × window_size, so the printed bar moves 40 → 20 against 21 reps). opened 14 Aug 2026 on his no-guessed-numbers ruling (§0 of UNLEASH_PLAN__2026-08-14.md): the old value was invented, this one is the smallest that lets the organ SPEAK on the data he actually has while keeping a non-zero floor. REFIT FROM 30d OF REAL DATA — this is a measurement window, not a verdict.
